name: stormwind-canal-fog
about: On the bank of the canal outside Stormwind's gate, looking over the water toward the bridge. The fog there was thick enough to hide the far bank (2026-10-04, the owner at game time 06:45). Shots in the normal view and in Debug Views 12 (how much gets through) and 14 (where mist collects).

start.about: the owner's place, read with ComfyTest pos; the camera faced 45.6 degrees, 10.7 down, about 8.6 yards behind

expect.about: The far side of the canal shows through the fog (Debug View 12, white = clear): it averaged 7 when low ground and water both thickened it
